extracted.intended_audience: public relations professionals, PR firms, communications officers, and press-release authors
extracted.subtask_description: Standards and evaluative criteria for preparing ethical, transparent press releases focused on disclosure, attribution, AI use, and avoidance of deceptive practices. Intended to guide PR firms and communicators in producing compliant, verifiable announcements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: The PR Council Code of Ethics specifically addresses Transparency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make relationships, sponsorships, and the origin of information clear and visible; avoid obfuscation and hidden agendas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: The PR Council Code of Ethics specifically addresses Disclosure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proactively disclose sponsorships, paid relationships, and other material ties that could influence the content or its perception.

rubrics_metrics.name: Honesty
rubrics_metrics.description: The PR Council Code of Ethics specifically addresses Honesty.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid misleading statements, fabrication, or exaggeration; ensure claims are accurate and supported by evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Client confidentiality
rubrics_metrics.description: The PR Council Code of Ethics specifically addresses Client confidentiality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Protect privileged client information while balancing disclosure obligations; obtain client consent for disclosures where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflicts of interest
rubrics_metrics.description: The PR Council Code of Ethics specifically addresses Conflicts of interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reveal any relationships or interests that could bias content or reporting; manage and disclose conflicts to stakeholders and media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoiding misleading practices
rubrics_metrics.description: The PR Council Code of Ethics specifically addresses Avoiding misleading practices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not use deceptive framing, selective facts, or manipulated media to distort the audience's understanding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoiding astroturfing
rubrics_metrics.description: The PR Council Code of Ethics specifically addresses Avoiding astroturfing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not create or hide orchestrated 'grassroots' activity; ensure any grassroots claims are genuine and not covertly sponsored.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor identification — source organization named
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the organization issuing the release prominently so recipients know who is responsible for the content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor identification — paid relationships disclosed
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reveal when content is produced, sponsored, or paid for by another party (e.g., advertorials, sponsored announcements).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor identification — client relationships disclosed
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the release promotes or references a client, make that relationship explicit to avoid hidden endorsements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Material information — do not suppress unfavorable information
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include material negative facts rather than withholding them; omission of key negatives can be deceptive and risk reputational/legal harm.

rubrics_metrics.name: Material information — acknowledge limitations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be transparent about the scope, reliability, and limits of data or claims; avoid presenting preliminary or uncertain results as definitive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Material information — provide complete context
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Situate facts within relevant background so readers can understand significance and avoid being misled by decontextualized figures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Material information — avoid selective disclosure
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid cherry-picking facts that create an incomplete or distorted picture; disclose both supportive and material adverse information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Source attribution — real people quoted
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use genuine quotes from named individuals; avoid fabricating or attributing quotations to nonexistent persons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Source attribution — verified credentials
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm and disclose the qualifications of quoted sources or experts; do not inflate or invent credentials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Source attribution — authentic experts
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rely on bona fide subject-matter experts for technical or evaluative claims; ensure they are independent where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Source attribution — no disguised paid testimonials
rubrics_metrics.description: No paid testimonials disguised as independent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose paid endorsements and avoid presenting paid statements as unprompted customer opinions.

rubrics_metrics.name: AI use disclosure — disclose AI-generated content where required
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If text, images, or other assets are generated by AI, state this clearly when applicable under emerging standards/regulation.

rubrics_metrics.name: AI use disclosure — verify AI-generated facts
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat AI outputs as draft material that must be fact-checked and verified before publication; do not rely on AI as an authoritative source.

rubrics_metrics.name: AI use disclosure — do not use AI to fabricate quotes
rubrics_metrics.description: Don't use AI to fabricate quotes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Never create fake person quotes via AI; quotes must be attributable to real individuals who consented.

rubrics_metrics.name: AI use disclosure — do not use AI for sensitive content without review
rubrics_metrics.description: Don't use AI for sensitive content without review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subject AI-generated or AI-assisted content about sensitive topics to human editorial and legal review before release.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authentic multimedia — use real photos unless disclosed
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer authentic photography; if images are AI-created or heavily edited, disclose that to avoid deception.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authentic multimedia — real testimonials
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use testimonials from real customers or participants and disclose any compensation; do not fabricate testimonials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authentic multimedia — real case studies
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure case studies reflect real events and obtain permissions for publication; avoid fictionalized case narratives presented as fact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authentic multimedia — disclose AI-created illustrations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Label or otherwise indicate when visual assets are generated or altered using AI tools to maintain transparency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Source organization clearly named (implicit rubric item)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press release should prominently state the issuing organization so accountability and origin are clear.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsorship/payment relationships disclosed (implicit rubric item)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reveal any financial arrangements influencing the release, including sponsorships and paid placements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflicts of interest revealed (implicit rubric item)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose relationships or interests that could reasonably be seen to affect the content or its neutrality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Real people quoted (implicit rubric item)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quotes must be from actual, identifiable people who have consented to the use of their words.

rubrics_metrics.name: Real photos used (implicit rubric item)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer authentic photos and disclose when imagery is synthetic or materially altered.

rubrics_metrics.name: AI use disclosed where required (implicit rubric item)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow jurisdictional/regulatory guidance on AI disclosure and label AI-assisted content appropriately.

rubrics_metrics.name: No astroturfing (implicit rubric item)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not create or hide orchestrated advocacy or fake grassroots movements; maintain clarity about who is organizing efforts.

rubrics_metrics.name: No fake testimonials (implicit rubric item)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid inventing endorsements or fabricating customer stories; verify and disclose any compensated testimonials.

rubrics_metrics.name: No suppression of material info (implicit rubric item)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Material adverse facts should not be omitted to create a misleadingly positive impression.

rubrics_metrics.name: No selective disclosure (implicit rubric item)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid cherry-picking facts; provide a balanced set of information relevant to understanding the announcement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliant with industry codes (implicit rubric item)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure releases adhere to relevant industry ethics codes such as PRSA, IPRA, and Global Alliance principles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliant with regulations (implicit rubric item)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow applicable laws and regulatory disclosure requirements (e.g., advertising, securities, consumer protection).

rubrics_metrics.name: Verifiable claims (implicit rubric item)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support assertions with verifiable evidence, citations, or data sources; avoid unsubstantiated or vague superlatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal review for material content (implicit rubric item)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subject potentially material, regulated, or litigious content to legal review prior to distribution to reduce risk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proper credentials of cited experts (implicit rubric item)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm and disclose the qualifications and affiliations of experts quoted or cited to avoid misrepresentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Astroturfing — fake grassroots campaigns (what counts as astroturfing)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid organizing or promoting campaigns that simulate independent public support when such support is manufactured or paid for.

rubrics_metrics.name: Astroturfing — disguised lobbying
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not present lobbying or advocacy as spontaneous citizen action; disclose the sponsor and intent of advocacy efforts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Astroturfing — hidden corporate sponsorship of 'citizen' groups
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose funding sources for groups or coalitions invoked in releases; do not obscure corporate backing of so-called grassroots entities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Astroturfing — paid commenters posing as customers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid planting paid online comments or reviews that impersonate genuine customers; disclose any compensated commentary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Astroturfing — hidden advertorial
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Label advertorial content and do not pass paid promotional material off as independent editorial content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Astroturfing — undisclosed paid endorsements
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure endorsements are properly disclosed when compensation or material ties exist; do not hide paid influence.
